name: Peanut Stew with Sweet Potato
summary: Sweet potato and chickpeas simmered in a tomato-peanut sauce over rice. Vegan.

ingredients.name: ground cumin, plus chili flakes to taste

instructions: Cook the rice according to package directions and set aside.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion 4 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin, and chili for 30 seconds.
Stir in the tomato paste and peanut butter, then the diced tomatoes and 500 mL water. Whisk smooth.
Add the sweet potato and chickpeas. Simmer 20–25 minutes until the sweet potato is tender and the sauce is thick.
Season with salt and serve over the rice.

glutenFree.notes: All ingredients are naturally gluten-free. Check the peanut butter label if you are highly sensitive.

budgetNotes: Peanut butter is the secret — it thickens the sauce and adds protein cheaply.
Stir in a handful of frozen spinach or greens at the end if you have them.
Keeps and reheats beautifully; make extra.
